parse_notes: Closed local observations on frozen synthetic benches. No generated answer, prompt, answer key, weight or machine log is published; no role is adopted.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B (NVIDIA), GGUF Q4_K_M (NVIDIA's 4GB repository, official), on the NVLink pair with -ts 30,12: all 42 layers (and the output layer) on GPU, and 3.5 GiB of the weights kept in system RAM by llama.cpp without an offload flag (no --n-cpu-moe; recorded as ram_spill), 16,384-token context, one llama.cpp slot, so the eight requests of the house protocol are served one after another.

Same weights and image as nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b-one-card, the conditional arm on the other topology. Single stream 112.9 tok/s against 141.1 for nemotron-3.5-bolt-e4b-one-card, aggregate 113.0 against 141.1 (three passes each, one slot): about 19.9 % slower single stream than one card, in all three passes.
The predeclared fit search loaded at its first setting (6.3 s).

Picked from a public model watch, downloaded at a fixed revision and checked by SHA-256, with its arms written and its fit searched before they ran; the conditional arm on the other topology ran after this model's planned arms had finished.

Run from 22:49 UTC on 24 October to 23:43 UTC (the night of 25 October in Swiss time), in a window opened that night with the owner's go-ahead right after the model watch; no process ran on the other pair of the host at the start of each arm.
